identity.retryPolicy: Transport failures (timeout (180s), network error, HTTP 408/409/429/5xx, unreadable API response with 5xx, incomplete or missing output) are retried up to 4 attempts per turn with exponential backoff honoring Retry-After and provider reset headers. Live calls use a 5-second minimum pace, increasing automatically to stay under 80% of a reported token/minute limit, and live episodes cool down by 30 seconds; every attempt and sanitized rate-limit header is recorded. Exhausted HTTP 429 retries interrupt the batch as infrastructure rather than counting as model failure. Invalid model output (unparseable JSON, schema violation, refusal) is not retried or repaired: it is recorded as an invalid response and terminates the episode as unsolved. A valid direction that is visibly blocked is not retried or repaired: it is executed as a blocked move, counts as a wall hit, consumes the turn, and the episode continues.

aiTransport.policy: Provider requests use the shared Vercel AI SDK transport with structured output. SDK retries are disabled; Echo Maze owns every retry, pacing delay, and attempt record.

identity.coordinateSystem: Walker-relative coordinates start at (0,0). A successful move right changes x by +1, left by -1, up by +1, down by -1. A blocked move changes nothing. The Walker never receives absolute maze rows/columns.
identity.hiddenStatePolicy: The prompt receives only the narrow observation DTO (open/blocked directions, corridor sightlines, per-visible-cell open directions and isExit flag, last action/result) plus the current run's conversation. No full maze, no exit coordinates, no seed, no optimal route, no unseen cells, and no spectator state may enter the prompt.

payload.notes: Start (0,0). Open: right, down; blocked: up,left. Sight: right corridor 2 cells then wall; down corridor 2 cells then wall. Exploring right first; track coordinates by successful moves.
At (1,0) after moving right. Current cell is horizontal corridor; right cell is open and branches down, while left returns toward start. Continue exploring right to reach the branch.
At (2,0); moved right successfully on prior turn. Right is blocked, with down and left open. Taking down to explore the branch; left corridor leads back toward start.
At (2,-1) after moving down. Open up and right; up returns to (2,0), while right enters a new cell with an upward branch. Explore right first.
At (3,-1) after successful right move. Open up and left; left backtracks, so move up to explore the new branch.
At (3,1) after the successful up move. Open right and down; both neighboring cells appear to lead onward, so explore right first and track the new branch.
At (4,0) after successful right move. Open up and left; left backtracks, so move up to explore the new branch.
At (4,1). Up is blocked; left is a long return corridor. Explore the right branch first, then investigate its downward continuation if needed.
At estimated (5,1) after the latest successful right move. Right and up are blocked; down enters an unexplored cell with an onward right branch, so move down.
At (5,0) after moving down. Open up and right; up returns to the prior branch, while right enters an unexplored corridor. Continue right.
At the current horizontal corridor after a successful right move. Left backtracks; right leads to an unexplored cell branching up and down. Continue right to explore the new branch.
At (7,0) after the successful right move. Right is blocked; up and down are unexplored branches. Explore up first, noting its next cell opens down and left.

At the cell reached by moving up from the junction. Left leads to a short dead-end corridor; down returns to the junction with an unexplored downward branch. Backtrack down, then investigate that branch.
At the junction after returning down from the explored upper dead end. Up is explored, left backtracks, and down is the remaining unexplored branch. Continue down.
At (7,0) after moving down from the junction. Open up and left; up returns to the explored junction, while left enters the remaining unexplored branch. Explore left.
At (6,-1) after moving left from the branch. Right returns to the previously explored junction; left and up are blocked. Down is the unexplored continuation, so explore down.
At (6,-2) after the successful down move. Up returns to the prior branch; right is unexplored and likely continues toward the exit. Explore right.
At (7,-2) after moving right. Right and up are blocked. Down is an unexplored corridor extending four cells and ending with a left branch; explore downward first.
At (7,-3) after moving down. The corridor continues downward for three cells and ends at a left branch; continue down to explore the remaining path.
At (7,-4) after moving down. The vertical corridor continues two cells downward and ends at a left branch; continue down to explore the remaining path.
At (7,-5) after moving down. The corridor continues one cell downward to a terminal left branch; continue down to reach that branch and explore it.
At (7,-6) after moving down. The corridor ends here with a left branch; explore left now.
At (6,-6) after moving left. The exit is visible in the cell directly down; move down to reach it.
